item.title: Positive News Section
item.description:
This section of my website is dedicated to positive news, whether it is in my personal life, or through my PhD journey.

To be active over the summer, I decided to stay active in the field, aside from my daily coding schedule. So, I applied for the 2025 Wood Family Fellowship at Drayton Hall Plantation, located in Charleston, SC. It is a fellowship to strengthen my museum studies skills and offer the institution the digital techniques I’ve learned throughout the semester. I know that there are a lot of artifacts that not only are not digitized but need a place within their collections, and that is what I am most excited about—creating a story for the voiceless and giving them a resting place that recognizes the historical significance of Drayton Hall Plantation. The Fellowship announcement will be on May 15th, 2025. Regardless of the results, I know it will not deter me from my career goal. Good luck to all applicants!

item.title: Welcome and Introduction to My Personal Portfolio
item.description:
Welcome to my personal website!

Hello, welcome to my academic website! I am Indira Lessington, a PhD student at Clemson University studying Digital History. My interests are 19-20th century African American History with a concentration on film, media, and photography. While an undergrad, I knew that the focus of African American Studies had to be centered not only on something I could relate to but also on understanding, interpreting, and conveying to students. I hold a BA in African/African American Studies and an MA in History with a concentration in Museum Studies.
